name: vector recall: derived index over the store, ranked with scores
summary: Delivered vector recall as a NEW exclusively-owned module python/synapse/memory/vector_recall.py: a rebuildable nearest-neighbour index built OVER the store's source memories as DERIVED data, returning ranked MemorySearchResult hits with REAL cosine scores. Dim is read from the active provider (no pin). All four acceptance predicates pass. Delivered as a new module (not by editing the declared-touches moneta_store.py) because that file is contested live by W3-KIND and held unreleased by W3-STORE; the module reads the store's PUBLIC surface only, so it is rebase-clean vs wave3/dim+store+kind.

crucible.criterion: index is never treated as source of truth; a lost index costs nothing but a rebuild
crucible.evidence: DerivedVectorIndex is in-memory, built on demand from store.all()/embedder; nothing persists it. test_index_is_derived_delete_rebuild_reproduces proves delete+rebuild-from-source reproduces recall bit-for-bit.

crucible.criterion: scores are real model outputs; a fabricated or constant score is a BLOCK
crucible.evidence: score = cosine of the embedder's own vectors (vector_recall.py:_cosine). test_scores_are_real_cosine_not_constant independently recomputes cosine and asserts equality to <1e-12, asserts scores are not all-equal, and asserts an exact-content query scores ~1.0.
